title: Orion-X Investigation Surface
note: Hand-maintained. tests/unit/test_osint_surface.sh is the gate: it fails if a local entry points at something that does not ship.
online_method: Every URL below was fetched with curl -L and returned HTTP 200 at its final effective address on 2026-10-03. Nothing that returned 403, 404, 000 or an unexpected redirect was kept. The list is deliberately shorter than it could be.

local.name: CyberChef 11.5.0
local.blurb: The cyber swiss-army knife, vendored and served from this deck. Defang, decode, decompress, carve, hash — ~500 operations, no upload, no network.

local.name: Orion-X Attack Map
local.blurb: Live tracers from this deck's own event bus. Sources it cannot locate are labelled UNLOCATED, never placed.

local.name: orionx-logquery
local.blurb: Forensic log correlation across journald, Suricata, Zeek and the nftables drop log, with preset IR reports.

local.name: Pivotglass (ap)
local.blurb: Adversary-infrastructure hunting: workspaces, evidence, provenance, a relationship graph and STIX 2 export. `ap web` serves its own local cockpit.

local.name: nucleotide
local.blurb: Attribution and fingerprinting over Nuclei scan output — what is this host, and who else looks like it.

local.name: artifact-analyzer.py
local.blurb: Triage a dropped artifact: type, hashes, strings, embedded structure.

local.name: pcap-analyzer.py
local.blurb: Summarise a capture: conversations, protocols, DNS, HTTP, TLS SNI. Wraps tshark.

local.name: orionx-capture
local.blurb: Bounded on-demand PCAP capture — size- and time-limited, so a capture cannot fill the disk under you.

local.name: Orion Cockpit
local.blurb: The live event stream, threat gauge and network sparkline the map's data comes from.

local.name: storyboard-gen.py
local.blurb: Turn findings into an intelligence storyboard you can hand to someone else.

local.name: orionx-diag
local.blurb: Does this deck actually have what it claims? Compares the running system against the build manifest.

local.name: orionx-freshen-intel
local.blurb: Refresh the local CISA KEV / threat-intel snapshot. Deliberately manual: when this deck reaches out is your decision.

local.name: exiftool
local.blurb: Read and strip metadata from images, documents and video — locally, which is the point. Never upload evidence to a web metadata service you did not have to.

local.name: whois
local.blurb: Registration data for a domain, IP range or ASN, straight from the registry.

local.name: dig / dnsutils
local.blurb: DNS by hand: ANY, AXFR attempts, specific resolvers, DNSSEC.

local.name: nmap
local.blurb: Host and service discovery. Remember the posture you are in before you scan anything.

local.name: tshark / wireshark
local.blurb: Full packet dissection on a capture you already took.

local.name: yara
local.blurb: Run signature rules against files or memory. Rulesets live in /opt/orionx/yara (orionx-freshen-yara fills them).

local.name: ssdeep
local.blurb: Fuzzy hashing — find the file that is almost the same as the one you already know.

local.name: foremost
local.blurb: Carve files out of a disk image or an unstructured blob by header signature.

local.name: binwalk
local.blurb: Find and extract embedded filesystems and compressed blobs inside firmware.

local.name: The Sleuth Kit
local.blurb: Filesystem-level forensics on an acquired image: fls, icat, mactime.

local.name: openssl
local.blurb: Inspect a certificate chain, decode a PEM, check a TLS endpoint's presented cert.
local.command: openssl s_client -connect host:443 -servername host </dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -text

local.name: Firefox ESR
local.blurb: The deck's browser. Everything on the ONLINE list opens here, when the posture allows it.

installable.name: GeoIP country + ASN labels
installable.blurb: DB-IP Lite (CC BY 4.0). Adds country and ASN LABELS to the attack map's sources. It does not add coordinates and the map still places nothing. ~10 MB, monthly data.

installable.name: Zeek network security monitor
installable.blurb: Protocol-level logging and notices; orionx-postured ingests its notice/weird/conn logs into the bus the map reads.

installable.name: Ghidra
installable.blurb: NSA's reverse-engineering suite. Deferred off the base image for size (DEC-PHASE11-004).

installable.name: FLOSS
installable.blurb: Mandiant's obfuscated-string extractor — the strings a packed sample does not hand you.

installable.name: TrID
installable.blurb: File-type identification by signature when `file` shrugs.

installable.name: ClamAV
installable.blurb: Signature scanning. Off the base image at -350 MB (DEC-PHASE11-009).

installable.name: DuckDB
installable.blurb: Columnar acceleration for orionx-logquery on very large captures. Not required.

online.name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
online.note: Bellingcat's curated, categorised index of open-source investigation tools with use cases and stated limitations.

online.name: Bellingcat Guides & How-Tos
online.note: Worked-example tutorials showing the actual technique behind published investigations.

online.name: OSINT Framework
online.note: Tree-structured map of OSINT tools organised by the kind of selector you start from.

online.name: OSINT Curious
online.note: Practitioner blog and webcast covering tradecraft, ethics and new technique write-ups.

online.name: OSINT Dojo
online.note: Free training path and practice exercises for building investigator skills from scratch.

online.name: Google Fact Check Explorer
online.note: Searches claims already rated by participating fact-checking organisations worldwide.

online.name: Snopes
online.note: Long-running debunking archive useful for recycled rumours and viral claims.

online.name: PolitiFact
online.note: Sourced rulings on political statements, with the evidence trail shown.

online.name: Full Fact
online.note: UK-focused independent fact-checking with published methodology and corrections.

online.name: IFCN signatory directory (Poynter)
online.note: Directory of signatory fact-checkers for finding a credible checker in a given country.

online.name: Google Maps
online.note: Baseline satellite, Street View and historical imagery for geolocating a scene.

online.name: OpenStreetMap
online.note: Open map data with queryable tags and full edit history for each feature.

online.name: Bing Maps
online.note: Second satellite/oblique imagery source, often from a different capture date than Google.

online.name: Esri World Imagery Wayback
online.note: Steps through archived global satellite basemaps to date a change on the ground.

online.name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
online.note: Free Sentinel/Landsat imagery by date and band combination for before/after comparison.

online.name: NASA Worldview
online.note: Near-real-time daily satellite layers including fire, smoke and flood detection.

online.name: SunCalc
online.note: Derives sun position and shadow direction for a coordinate and time, to chronolocate a photo.

online.name: Overpass Turbo
online.note: Queries OpenStreetMap for every feature matching a tag within an area.

online.name: Google Images (reverse)
online.note: Reverse image search for earlier publications of a supposedly new photo.

online.name: Yandex Images (reverse)
online.note: Reverse image search, notably strong on faces, buildings and Eastern European content.

online.name: Forensically (29a.ch)
online.note: Error-level analysis, clone and noise detection. Runs in the browser; the image is not uploaded.

online.name: FotoForensics
online.note: ELA and metadata inspection for spotting edited regions in a JPEG.
online.caution: Uploads the image to a third party, which keeps it. Use exiftool and Forensically locally first.

online.name: ExifTool (upstream)
online.note: Documentation for the tool already installed on this deck. Read it here, run it locally.

online.name: YouTube Metadata (mattw.io)
online.note: Exact upload timestamp, geotag and comment history for a YouTube video.

online.name: OpenCorporates
online.note: Cross-jurisdiction company register search linking officers and addresses across entities.

online.name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database
online.note: Searchable graph of offshore entities and officers from the Panama/Paradise/Pandora leaks.

online.name: OCCRP Aleph
online.note: Cross-searches hundreds of leaks, registries and sanctions lists from one query box.

online.name: UK Companies House
online.note: Free authoritative UK filings, directors and beneficial-ownership records.

online.name: OFAC Sanctions List Search
online.note: Official US Treasury check of a name against SDN and consolidated sanctions lists.

online.name: OpenSanctions
online.note: Merged global sanctions, PEP and watchlist data with provenance for each record.

online.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
online.note: Historical snapshots of a page after the live version is altered or deleted.

online.name: archive.today
online.note: On-demand frozen snapshots that capture content Wayback often misses or is blocked from.

online.name: Archive-It
online.note: Curated institutional web collections, useful for government and conflict-related sites.

online.name: Arquivo.pt
online.note: Portuguese national web archive with full-text search across historical page content.

online.name: crt.sh
online.note: Certificate Transparency search that exposes subdomains an organisation never advertised.
online.caution: Returned HTTP 502 on 2 of 5 checks during verification. If it is down, use the Google CT entry below.

online.name: Google Transparency Report — Certificates
online.note: Second independent Certificate Transparency search, for when crt.sh is unavailable.

online.name: urlscan.io
online.note: Sandboxed page loads showing redirect chains, resources and screenshots without visiting the site.
online.caution: Public scans are visible to everyone. Choose an unlisted scan when the URL itself is sensitive.

online.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
online.note: ASN, prefix and peering lookups for attributing IP space to an operator.

online.name: RIPEstat
online.note: Registry, routing-history and geolocation data for any IP, prefix or ASN.

online.name: DNSDumpster
online.note: Passive DNS and subdomain mapping for a domain's visible attack surface.

online.name: ICANN Lookup
online.note: Official registration-data lookup for domain creation dates and registrar of record.

online.name: Shodan
online.note: Searches internet-exposed services by banner, product and location.

online.name: ADS-B Exchange Globe
online.note: Unfiltered live aircraft tracking that does not honour owner block lists.

online.name: OpenSky Network
online.note: Research-grade historical ADS-B archive for reconstructing past flights.

online.name: FlightAware
online.note: Flight history by tail number or route, including airport activity records.

online.name: VesselFinder
online.note: Live AIS ship positions plus vessel particulars, owner and port-call history.

online.name: Have I Been Pwned
online.note: Whether an address appears in known breach corpora, to pivot to exposure sources.
online.caution: You are typing a subject's address into someone else's search box.

online.name: WhatsMyName
online.note: Enumerates a username across hundreds of platforms using validated detection rules.

online.name: Sherlock (source)
online.note: Open-source CLI username enumerator. Clone it and run it from this deck rather than using a web front end.

online.name: VirusTotal
online.note: Multi-engine file, URL and hash reputation with pivotable relationship graphs.
online.caution: Uploading a sample publishes it. Search the SHA-256 first; upload only when you accept that the adversary may see it.

online.name: MalwareBazaar
online.note: Free sample repository searchable by hash, YARA rule, tag or family.

online.name: URLhaus
online.note: Community feed of URLs actively distributing malware, with payload hashes.

online.name: Malpedia
online.note: Curated, citation-backed encyclopedia of malware families and threat-actor aliases.

online.name: ANY.RUN
online.note: Interactive sandbox for observing a sample's runtime behaviour and network callbacks.
online.caution: Free-tier submissions are public. Treat every upload as disclosure.

online.name: AlienVault OTX
online.note: Community threat-intel pulses linking indicators to campaigns and reports.
